description: FREE. After sending at least $0.20 (24 h) or $1.00 (30 days) USDC on Base to 0x7C1F5120B22ce1Fc0E7972e68F322d40B49578aD in one transfer, give the transaction hash here to get the pass. The pass runs from the transfer's block time. Keep the pass to yourself: whoever holds it can use it until it expires. A pass redeemed from a plain transfer can be redeemed by anyone who knows that transaction hash (hashes are public on-chain), so redeem right after paying.

tx.description: Base transaction hash of the USDC transfer (0x + 64 hex).
